title: Boddington 自動化金銅礦

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Boddington 自動化金銅礦案例中比較金銅grade分佈與露天autonomous haulage，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate gold/copper grades and surface autonomous haulage within the Boddington automated gold/copper mine case.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對金銅grade分佈提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for gold/copper grades.
steps.instruction: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識金銅grade分佈。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gold/copper grades in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交金銅grade分佈的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gold/copper grades.

knowledge.title: 資源品位與代表採樣
knowledge.text: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 本課架構對應：金銅grade分佈
knowledge.textEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Course architecture correspondence: Gold/copper grades

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設乾給料900 t、品位1.6 g/t、金屬回收率0.85，可回收金屬=1224.0 g=1.2240 kg。回收率不同於精礦品位；未含礦物解離、處理成本或任何浸出配方，非礦場實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume dry feed 900 t, grade 1.6 g/t and metal recovery 0.85: recovered metal 1224.0 g=1.2240 kg. Recovery differs from concentrate grade; liberation/costs and all leaching recipes are excluded; this is not a mine measurement.

quiz.question: 就金銅grade分佈的「資源品位與代表採樣」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for resources, grade and representative sampling in gold/copper grades?
options: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。
最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate.
The best sample represents every ore parcel.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
quiz.explanationEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對金銅grade分佈提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for gold/copper grades.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「資源品位與代表採樣」模型，檢查金銅grade分佈的兩個假想案例。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous resources, grade and representative sampling model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving gold/copper grades. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交金銅grade分佈的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gold/copper grades.

steps.title: 開坑地下與搬運：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Open-pit, underground and haulage: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對露天autonomous haulage提出可反駁的開坑地下與搬運模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable open-pit, underground and haulage model and evidence record for surface autonomous haulage.
steps.instruction: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識露天autonomous haulage。露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 建立開坑地下與搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify surface autonomous haulage in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：露天與地下可沿用所有支護和搬運參數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Surface and underground systems share every support/haulage parameter.
steps.check: 提交露天autonomous haulage的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for surface autonomous haulage.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate size/liberation and feed/concentrate balance within the Boddington automated gold/copper mine case.

steps.title: 粒徑解離與破碎：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Particle size, liberation and comminution: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對粒度與解離提出可反駁的粒徑解離與破碎模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable particle size, liberation and comminution model and evidence record for size/liberation.
steps.instruction: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識粒度與解離。粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 建立粒徑解離與破碎的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify size/liberation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of particle size, liberation and comminution, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：研磨越細就必然提升全部經濟與環境指標。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Finer grinding improves every economic/environmental metric.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable tailings, water and rehabilitation model and evidence record for mine water/tailings/rehabilitation.

steps.objective: 針對礦水尾礦與覆育提出可反駁的尾礦水與復育模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable tailings, water and rehabilitation model and evidence record for mine water/tailings/rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「尾礦水與復育」模型，檢查礦水尾礦與覆育的兩個假想案例。比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous tailings, water and rehabilitation model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving mine water/tailings/rehabilitation. Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.
steps.check: 提交礦水尾礦與覆育的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mine water/tailings/rehabilitation.

knowledge.title: 尾礦水與復育
knowledge.text: 尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 本課架構對應：礦水尾礦與覆育
knowledge.textEn: Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Course architecture correspondence: Mine water/tailings/rehabilitation

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設乾給料900 t、品位1.6 g/t、金屬回收率0.85，可回收金屬=1224.0 g=1.2240 kg。回收率不同於精礦品位；未含礦物解離、處理成本或任何浸出配方，非礦場實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume dry feed 900 t, grade 1.6 g/t and metal recovery 0.85: recovered metal 1224.0 g=1.2240 kg. Recovery differs from concentrate grade; liberation/costs and all leaching recipes are excluded; this is not a mine measurement.

quiz.question: 就礦水尾礦與覆育的「尾礦水與復育」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for tailings, water and rehabilitation in mine water/tailings/rehabilitation?
options: 回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。
optionsEn: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence.
quiz.explanation: 尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence.

summary: 以露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收解析Boddington 自動化金銅礦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Boddington automated gold/copper mine through surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 公開資源工程的離線質量、能量及環境證據判讀；不提供鑽井、井控、採掘、爆破或危險化學浸出SOP。採礦權、許可、地質完整性與現場規範需由合格團隊另行確認，課程完成不是操作資格。
scopeEn: Offline public resource-engineering material/energy/environmental analysis; no drilling, well-control, excavation, blasting or hazardous-leaching SOP. Qualified teams separately establish rights, permits, integrity and field requirements; completion is not operating qualification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設乾給料900 t、品位1.6 g/t、金屬回收率0.85，可回收金屬=1224.0 g=1.2240 kg。回收率不同於精礦品位；未含礦物解離、處理成本或任何浸出配方，非礦場實測。
workedExample.textEn: Assume dry feed 900 t, grade 1.6 g/t and metal recovery 0.85: recovered metal 1224.0 g=1.2240 kg. Recovery differs from concentrate grade; liberation/costs and all leaching recipes are excluded; this is not a mine measurement.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.
